subject: website
name: Gnoma
summary: Gnoma, an unofficial explorer for Anoma settlements, the shielded pool and the XAN token. Its bundle is minified with no source map and no public repository of its own was found, so it stays at Level 2. When it opens it also calls an API at exploreanoma.com and loads Google Fonts, and it relies on that server for its data.

operations.name: View overview, latest settlements and analytics
operations.note: Data comes from the exploreanoma.com API, a centralised backend.

operations.name: Read chain data through public RPC endpoints
operations.note: RPC URLs are named in the bundle; no light client checks the answers.

connections.name: Explorer API (exploreanoma.com)
connections.note: Overview and recent-transactions data fetched when the page opens, and retried.

connections.name: Public RPC endpoints (1rpc.io, dRPC, PublicNode and others)
connections.note: Named in the bundle for chain reads, without a light client.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens, with no integrity hash; tells Google the visit.
